summary: The Forbidden Reach is the island off the Dragon Isles where Neltharion made the dracthyr and trained them, a place of storm-lashed coast, frozen spine and hollowed-out creches. It slept for an age after the battle that emptied it, and the dracthyr slept with it. It is awake now: the four weyrns are back on their old ground, morqut tuskarr have settled the western islet, and the Earth-Warder's workshops and the Zskera Vaults are being opened by people who did not build them.
history: Neltharion shaped the island as a proving ground for soldiers he designed himself, and the dracthyr were raised and drilled in creches sunk into it — one for war, one for siege, one to support and one to heal, each weyrn made for a purpose and told nothing else. A battle ended that, and the Earth-Warder sealed the island and everything in it. Nobody landed for ages; a flier who tried was struck out of the sky. The dracthyr woke when an old enemy stirred, and coming back they found their birthplace picked over — vaults broken open, tarasek in the tunnels, and a great deal of what Neltharion left behind still working.
factions: Dracthyr of the Obsidian Warders, Dark Talons, Ebon Scales and Healing Wings

notable.name: Zskera Vaults
notable.what: The warren of locked rooms on Morqut Islet, opened one key at a time to see what the Earth-Warder stored there

notable.name: Morqut Village
notable.what: The tuskarr settlement on the islet, and the only place on the Reach where anyone offers a stranger a meal

notable.name: Earth-Warder's Cauldron
notable.what: Neltharion's own works, where the dracthyr were made rather than merely trained
